placeabout.heading: About this place
placeabout.description:
Oldbury Court brings together open parkland and wooded paths beside the River Frome. You can keep your visit focused on the play park or explore towards Snuff Mills for a longer outing.

Our family idea: pack a snack and turn a short walk into a listening game. Pause to notice running water, birds and the different sounds underfoot, then finish with time on the play equipment.

placepracticalinfo.heading: Practical information
placepracticalinfo.bestFor: Playground visits and families who enjoy riverside walks.
placepracticalinfo.facilities: Children's play park, picnic space and a park kiosk.
placepracticalinfo.parking: Car parks serve Oldbury Court Road and Snuff Mills; check charges and gates before leaving your car.
placepracticalinfo.goodToKnow: Riverside paths can be muddy or uneven. Stay close to children near the river and choose your route to match their energy.
